scope.native_cells: opaque tagged Cell identities; graph vertices are not carrier vertices
scope.native_adjacency: finite simple 2-regular graph on opaque Cells
scope.pf10: one identical opaque local PF-10 token at every Cell
scope.guard: carrier S4 and local presentation data are observations, not native Cell identity

typed_probe_family_P_r.SLICE: four accepted carrier star readouts on the tagged six-axis fiber
typed_probe_family_P_r.ROT: all words in the accepted carrier S4 action on the local axis fiber
typed_probe_family_P_r.N_r: rooted induced native-adjacency ball of radius r with transported local decorations
typed_probe_family_P_r.observation_profile: multiset over opaque Cells of typed probe-output isomorphism classes

equivalence_separation.cell_isomorphism: bijection of opaque Cells preserving native adjacency and all tagged local structures
equivalence_separation.probe_isomorphism: root-preserving typed isomorphism of probe outputs; opaque root identity is forgotten
equivalence_separation.presentation_relabeling: local label reindexing transported through readouts; it is not native Cell equality

theorems.name: LOCAL_FACTORIZATION
theorems.statement: For uniform local six-axis/slice/rotation/PF-10 decorations, every P_r observation factors through the multiset of rooted radius-r native adjacency balls.

theorems.name: MINIMAL_RADIUS1_COLLISION
theorems.statement: Within the declared 2-regular class, the smallest nonisomorphic P_1-indistinguishable pair has eight Cells: X=C8 and Y=C4 disjoint_union C4. It is the unique collision through n<=8 at cycle-partition level.

theorems.name: RADIUS2_SEPARATION_OF_MINIMAL_PAIR
theorems.statement: N_2 separates the minimal pair: a root in C8 sees a five-vertex rooted path, while a root in C4 sees the whole four-cycle.

theorems.name: FIXED_RADIUS_GLOBAL_NO_GO
theorems.statement: For every fixed r>=1 and every m>=2r+2, X_r=C_(2m) and Y_r=C_m disjoint_union C_m are nonisomorphic but have identical P_r profiles. Therefore no fixed-radius local probe family is globally reconstruction-complete on the unbounded declared class.

minimal_countermodel.minimality_scope: all finite simple 2-regular graphs with the frozen uniform local decoration and <=8 Cells

missing_probe_class.for_minimal_pair: radius-2 native neighborhood / four-cycle closure probe
missing_probe_class.for_unbounded_class: radius that scales with native component diameter, or a genuinely nonlocal path/connectivity/gluing probe
missing_probe_class.negative_classification: adding any single fixed finite radius cannot give global completeness on the unbounded 2-regular class

philosophical_interpretation.yoneda_guard: The full Yoneda principle concerns all maps from a sufficiently rich test category. A restricted finite/local probe family need not be jointly conservative.
philosophical_interpretation.project_consequence: Do not infer native six-dimensional identity from equality of carrier/local observations. First prove the chosen probe family jointly separates the declared model class, or record its exact kernel of indistinguishability.
philosophical_interpretation.abstraction_guard: No topos/stack upgrade is needed to state this obstruction; the first missing object is a stronger probe/gluing semantics.

nonclaims: Does not reduce six native spatial dimensions.
Does not identify carrier vertices with native Cells.
Does not claim all currently imaginable P000 probes are local.
Does not prove mathematical novelty of the graph-locality phenomenon.
Does not promote carrier S4 to the full native P000 rotation group.
